Jack, Sofia, Omar and Hana set out to build a domino donkey in a timed round. Jack first picked a chicken, but Sofia flagged that the vegetarian café might reject it, and he switched. The team split the work: Jack the tail, back and neck; Sofia the head; Omar the ears and belly; Hana the legs.

The first turn came at the neck. "Heads up, the head didn't land," Sofia said, so she carried it round the face by hand. Omar then got the ears down after Hana pointed out they weren't.

The belly gave the most trouble. Sofia re-laid the whole line, Hana fixed a kink, and Omar bridged a gap at the chest. Then hands went off, and the start domino was pushed.

106 of 162 fell. Everyone called it a donkey, but the blind judges guessed a tree branch, a bird or dog, and a winding river.
